enrollment.title: Student enrollment
enrollment.intro: Everything you need to know before you apply.
enrollment.body:
How enrollment works

  1. Choose a program

    Compare programs on the courses page.

  2. Check eligibility

    Each program lists the qualification it requires.

  3. Create a student account

    Register once to track your applications.

  4. Apply online

    Complete the form in the admission portal, including guardian details.

  5. Submit documents

    The admissions office will contact you to collect scanned copies.

  6. Pay fees and confirm

    Your seat is confirmed once the first fee payment is received.

Documents to keep ready

  • National ID card or B-form
  • Previous academic transcripts and certificates
  • Recent passport-size photographs
  • Guardian ID copy

Fee details and deadlines are confirmed by the admissions office.

Go to the admission portal
